primary:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create the final primary horizontal logo for "Alan Luby Photography", an artistic, refined, authentic, premium but approachable professional photography brand. Exceptionally polished high-end design-studio art direction, timeless editorial typography, very clean flat vector-style edges.
Canvas: wide horizontal 3:1 composition, genuinely transparent RGBA background, generous but not excessive clear space. One logo only, no presentation board.
Layout: bespoke compact "AL" monogram at left; to its right the main wordmark "ALAN LUBY" in beautifully balanced uppercase refined serif lettering with moderate, confident tracking. Beneath the wordmark, "PHOTOGRAPHY" in smaller restrained uppercase sans-serif lettering, evenly spaced and highly readable, centered beneath the name. Spell all text exactly: A L A N [space] L U B Y, P H O T O G R A P H Y. No other text.
Monogram: a distinctive geometric capital A interlocked with a clear capital L; make the L's horizontal foot feel like the lower edge of a photographic frame. A single tiny open framing corner can suggest a viewfinder, integrated with the monogram geometry. Prioritize unmistakably readable AL and an elegant memorable silhouette. Intentional balanced negative space; no camera body, no stock aperture blades, no decorative circle or generic lens icon. Compact optical square proportions. Refined medium-weight strokes, not fragile hairlines.
Palette: solid charcoal #242422 for wordmark and main monogram; a single restrained muted gold #A38A58 framing accent. Warm ivory #F4F0E8 is the intended light application surface, but DO NOT draw a background: this master logo must be transparent. Artwork must preserve its identity when rendered entirely in pure black or entirely in white.
No gradients, no metallic effects, no shadows, no textures, no mockup, no watermark, no slogans, no labels, no extra logos. Premium clean geometry, optically balanced spacing, crisp print-design finish.
monogram:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset: standalone compact AL brand monogram.
Input image: the supplied transparent horizontal Alan Luby Photography logo is the identity reference and edit target.
Extract and present ONLY the AL monogram at the LEFT of this reference as a separate square-format logo asset. Faithfully preserve its exact serif A and L letter geometry, interlocking relationship, large open triangular A counter, tall L with sweeping lower foot, and the small muted-gold upper-right photographic framing corner. This is the same identity, not a redesign.
Center the monogram in a square transparent canvas with approximately 16% clear margin on all four sides. Remove the words ALAN LUBY and PHOTOGRAPHY entirely. Only the AL emblem remains.
Use crisp perfectly flat solid charcoal #242422 for letters and muted gold #A38A58 for the little framing corner, clean vector-style edges. Preserve the meaningful transparent negative spaces between and inside letters. No textures, shadows, gradients, metallic rendering, background fill, border, checkerboard, labels or extra text. Genuinely transparent RGBA background.
